comment: Dr. Halperin is a very nice lady who helped me out on essays and even helped me find sources for them. She definitely looks out for students if you need help. However, the class being mostly entirely lecture was rough. The readings are mostly 20 pages plus. It's a lot of reading and difficult to know what she wants. Participation is key.

Dr. Halperin is very knowledgeable about historical events. However, her teaching style is not conducive to learning. She mostly stands in the front of the room and lectures, and awkwardly asks occasional questions. She is not an engaging speaker by any stretch of the imagination. She also assigns unreasonably long reading assignments.

Professor Halperin is very nice and helpful one on one but the class can be very boring at times. Most students find it difficult to stay focused the entire class and it's easy to zone out. Expect lectures and heavy reading.
Class is boring. Three papers and a final. Papers are not graded hard, but need to put time into them. Readings are long, but as long as you can make a few points in class you are fine.

Class was half lecture and half discussion. Lots of reading. She gets upset when people don't participate in discussion and will give reading quizzes if she thinks people aren't doing the reading. Willing to read drafts of papers but not super helpful. Only good about telling you what's wrong or needs to be fixed, not how to fix it.

She is a great professor and she is always willing to help. I had her for History 199 this fall semester and she was always helpful. She is a hard grader, but she always offers to read rough drafts of papers.
Class is very boring, mainly lecture based. She likes to hear herself talk. Not a lot of homework however and only 3 Papers in the semester. The final was a take home test but very difficult.

The class was somewhat interesting, but it was tough. She was a hard grader, and I worked very hard for my B-. Although attendance wasn't mandatory, she would take points off of participation if you didn't attend class. She offered to read papers before their due date, but would then contradict herself when you turned them in. Tough class.
Her class is boring, she grades ambiguously and corrects your papers in a way that's not correct, because obviously she doesn't know English. She's a bitter nerd. DON'T TAKE HER CLASS.

Worst class I've ever taken. Hardest class to sit through, impossible to stay engaged. She's a nice lady, however, grading is ambiguous and class is boring. I'd advise no one to take this class. I worked hard and got a B+. I would never take it again though.

I think that many times she would just be content to lock herself in the library of congress for the rest of her life. Very dry lectures and gets annoyed when students don't respond to ridiculous questions.  Unclear grading standards on papers. She plays favorites, so get on her good side!
I liked her style, lecture, but some people prefer discussion.
She's generally nice and knowledgeable, but can be boring and VERY awkward.  However she'll randomly be funny and will definately help students if you ask.

I disagree with the person who said no matter how hard you tried in 299 you would get a B.  I'm not brilliant by any means and I got an A-.  Halperin is also pretty helpful, but you need to talk to her after class like the week before essays are due so she knows/thinks you're interested in the class. Shes a baller. Hov!

This is the kind of class that no matter how hard you tried, you were going to get a "B," even though it was mostly a hardcore recap of AP US.  Discussions are awkward since she never responds to anyone's comments.
Lecture is kind of fast paced, sometimes almost too fast, but she is extremely knowledgeable about the material and also very helpful and available when you need it.
So nice and helpful and a fair grader. Makes the class as about as interesting as it can be; says funny stuff if you're listening.
Wicked nice lady.  Interesting class too.  Learned a lot.  Thats about it.
way too much reading...

First of all, the class material is a complete bore, it didn't help that the teacher was entirely the same. She's an extremely critical grader and somehow appreciates dumb b.s. comments a lot more than valid, constructive thought. Take this class and you'll be hating life.
